highlight.title: The Chelsea Detective
highlight.badge: Acorn TV Original · Season 4 Premiere · August 3
highlight.description: DI Max Arnold (Adrian Scarborough) and DS Layla Walsh (Vanessa Emme) return to investigate four new murder cases in the glamorous London borough of Chelsea. New episodes stream weekly on Acorn TV starting August 3.

new_arrivals.title: Blue Murder Motel
new_arrivals.description: Married retired detectives Vanessa and Peter Coleman leave their cop careers behind to run a motel in a sunny beachside New Zealand town — only for a body to turn up in Unit 3 just a week after opening, dragging their old instincts back into gear.

new_arrivals.title: The Ridge
new_arrivals.description: Lauren Lyle (Outlander) stars as a Scottish anesthetist who arrives in New Zealand for her sister's wedding, only to find her dead. A psychological thriller of grief, secrets, and small-town lies, continuing weekly through its August 31 finale.

new_arrivals.title: You're Killing Me
new_arrivals.description: Brooke Shields stars as a bestselling novelist who teams up with an aspiring podcaster to solve her friend's murder in a quaint New England town. All six episodes are now available to stream in full — a cozy mystery with genuine charm.

originals.title: Midsomer Murders
originals.description: The ultimate comfort watch — impossibly picturesque English villages with an impossibly high murder rate. 25+ series of warm, witty, completely addictive mystery. The show that defines cozy British TV.

originals.title: Agatha Raisin
originals.description: Ashley Jensen is irresistible as the sharp London PR exec who retires to the Cotswolds and keeps stumbling into murders. Funny, warm, and completely bingeable — based on M.C. Beaton's beloved novels.

originals.title: Art Detectives
originals.description: DI Mick Palmer (Stephen Moyer) and DC Shazia Malik solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques — from Old Master paintings to Banksy street art. Six clever, stylish episodes now streaming in full.

originals.title: Doc Martin
originals.description: A grumpy London surgeon retreats to a tiny Cornish fishing village as its GP. Ten series of the warmest, funniest comedy drama British TV has produced. Port Wenn is the village you'll wish you lived in.
